mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL nums.n DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COALESCE(s.treat_volume, 0) AS treatVolume FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 ) nums LEFT JOIN biz_health_org_svc s ON DATE(s.stat_time) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL nums.n DAY) AND s.med_org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY date
